task.title: Build and download a pack
task.shortdesc: The pack is a zip with the DITA-OT output, the manifest, a report, a coverage table and SHA-256 hashes.

info.p: The button is off while a leak blocks release.

step.cmd: Open the zip and read report.html.
Check the hashes: run sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS in the pack folder.

result.p: The documentation folder holds the HTML5 and PDF output that DITA-OT built in CI from the corpus commit with this reader's DITAVAL profile. A sandbox pack is hashed but never sealed.
